title: Great towel
text: Great towel. As the ad states " these are not towel size". They are the size of 2 wash clothes together. But even for thier small size, they are very absorbant. Im usually leary about towels for that because so many just smear the water over the dish. But these actually absorb it. They can be great for cleaning off tables and counters or what ever you want. Very nice color and all around great product.
